en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a line of German soldiers in parade formation on a cobblestone street in front of large brick barracks buildings. The men wear pickelhaube-style helmets and dark uniforms, holding rifles with bayonets fixed. Young trees line the street. German text is printed at the top and bottom of the image, identifying the location and the military unit.
